messages:
incidents-bot: Pager triggered for P2: billing/usage display mismatch across dashboard and invoice preview (alert rule: metering.usage.delta > 5%). Paging oncall.

maria: I’m on it. seeing a surge of backfill jobs failing in the invoicing pipeline. logs show 50% of jobs for window 2026-03-12 are marked COMPLETED but with zero usage rows.

jordan: oncall-eng please confirm — is this the new async-agg worker we rolled out yesterday? :thinking_face:

oncall-eng: yup that's the new async-agg v2. Deployed 03/14 22:07 UTC. I can repro locally — aggregator emits success but downstream ledger writes intermittently drop shard 7.

nirav: paging schema team — could this be a serialization/compatibility issue? v2 changed column ordering for compact rows.

maria: good call. I’m seeing this stack snippet in the worker logs:

```
ERROR: failed to write ledger batch: ErrPartialSync{missing_shards=[7]} at aggregator/worker.go:412
WARN: backoff and retry suppressed (already attempted 3 times)
```

jordan: if missed shard writes are allowed then UI fetches partial ledger and invoices show 0 usage for affected customers. We need a mitigation asap — surface customers affected and run targeted reprocess.

product-ops: heads up — CS and PMs will need a short customer comm if invoices or usage preview is wrong. 

cs-lead: yep. please tag me when you have the impact list. I'll draft a customer note and escalation for top 20 accounts.

maria: mitigation plan draft:
1) pause async-agg v2 rollout (rollback to v1) — stops further partial writes
2) requeue failed ledger batches for shards [7] for window 2026-03-12..2026-03-14
3) run `reprocess_invoices --shards=7 --from=2026-03-12 --to=2026-03-14 --priority=high`
4) verify UI + invoice preview after reprocess; push status update

oncall-eng: I can roll back v2 now. Starting rollback in 2 min. ETA 3-5m.

nirav: while rollback goes we should also prepare a quick status-page message and a customer template. Drafting below — feel free to copy/edit.

product-ops: paste it here pls.

nirav: STATUS PAGE (short):
We are investigating an issue causing some customers to see incorrect usage in the dashboard and invoice previews. Root cause: a partial write regression in an aggregator worker introduced in a recent rollout. We have paused the rollout and are reprocessing affected data. We expect corrected usage to appear within 4 hours. We will post updates here and notify customers with impacted invoices directly.

CS TEMPLATE (for affected customers):
Hi <Customer Name>,

Thanks for flagging this. Our engineering team identified an intermittent issue that caused some invoice previews and usage graphs to show lower-than-expected usage between 2026-03-12 and 2026-03-14. We have paused the rollout that introduced the regression and are reprocessing affected records now. You should see corrected values within 4 hours. No billing transactions have been finalized; any invoice changes will be communicated clearly. We’re sorry for the inconvenience — let me know if you want a direct sync with our billing ops team. — <CS rep>

maria: rollback completed. v1 is back in production. No new failures in the last 6 minutes. Starting requeue of missing batches now.

incidents-bot: Deployment rollback event recorded: deploy-20260314-agg-v1 (initiated by oncall-eng) — link: https://ci.internal/deploys/3489

jordan: reprocess job started. progress: 0/312 batches.

maria: quick note on verification: we'll run a compare job after reprocess:

```
SELECT customer_id, sum(usage_tokens) FROM ledger WHERE window >= '2026-03-12' GROUP BY customer_id
```

and compare to snapshot taken at 2026-03-14 21:00 UTC.

cs-lead: thanks. drafting email now. pinging top 20 customers list.

product-ops: notify status-page: short note + link to longer explanation and CS contact. Keep it non-technical.

jordan: reprocess progress update: 50/312 batches (16%) — requeue ok, no new write errors.

nirav: quick checklist for postmortem notes (to capture in incident doc):
- root cause: compact-row column reordering in async-agg v2 not backwards compatible with ledger writer
- impact: partial ledger sync for shard 7 leading to incorrect invoice previews for ~1.2% active customers, delayed invoice previews for ~4% customers
- mitigation: rollback, reprocess, add integration test for compact-row compatibility
- customer comms: status page, targeted CS emails, internal incident summary

maria: reprocess finished. 312/312 batches reprocessed. Ran compare, differences corrected for affected customers. Running invoice preview regen for accounts with open draft invoices.

jordan: verification pass: dashboard + invoice preview match ledger snapshots for sample of 200 accounts.

cs-lead: sending customer email now (using template). will BCC billing-ops and PMs. I'll add a short offer for a credit if any customer reports downstream effects.

product-ops: status page update: fixed. Message:
"A recent issue that caused incorrect usage to appear in some dashboards and invoice previews has been resolved. We paused a rollout, reprocessed affected data, and verified corrected values. No finalized charges were changed. If you see unexpected differences, contact billing@redwood.ai and we’ll investigate." 

oncall-eng: adding follow-ups to the incident ticket: revert integration tests + require binary compatibility check before agg rollouts. assigning to nirav and maria for remediation.

maria: looping in product-ops for post-incident comms review. Also adding one-off monitoring: alert on ErrPartialSync occurrences > 1 in 10m window.

incidents-bot: Incident closed (P2) — duration 00:47:28. Incident record: https://incidents.redwood.ai/1998765432

cs-lead: thanks team. I’ll ping if any customers escalate. Great job on the quick rollback and reprocess. :clap:

jordan: one more note — please add the customer-facing template used to the incident doc as an appendix.

maria: done. saved draft and attached to incident record. closing thread.
